dossier.scp_unleashed.007.title: Abdominal Planet
dossier.scp_unleashed.007.caption: SCP-007 as first found, sitting in a meadow beside an untouched cake.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-007 is cooperative and is to be housed in a standard humanoid cell furnished with a bed, a rug and a window. He may be escorted around the site on request.
Personnel are not to touch, press or poke SCP-007-1. Meals do not need to be provided, but SCP-007 appreciates being asked.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-007 is a man of average build with pale skin, tired eyes and untidy blond hair. He wears a D-Class jumpsuit that has been left open at the middle.

Where his abdomen should be there is a hollow, framed by his lower ribs and spine. Inside it turns SCP-007-1: a small planet with oceans, continents, clouds and polar ice, spinning slowly on a tilted axis.
SCP-007 is calm, polite and a little sleepy. He spends long periods sitting cross-legged, watching SCP-007-1 turn.
The subject has not shown the need for either food or water. Offers of a meal are always declined, kindly.

page.title: Addendum 007-1: Recovery
text: SCP-007 was found sitting cross-legged in a meadow, looking down at SCP-007-1. A cake left beside him by a passing farmer had not been touched. He came with the recovery team willingly.
He has only been met after this file has been opened.

page.title: Addendum 007-2: Night Shift
text: Researcher %rHolt%r asked to be moved to the night shift, saying SCP-007-1 is "nicer to look at after dark". He would not explain further.
When asked, SCP-007 said only: "Please keep your voice down. They're sleeping."

message.scp_unleashed.scp007.speaker: SCP-007
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.refuses: SCP-007 shakes his head slowly. He is minding something important
SCP-007, "Abdominal Planet": a quiet man in a D-Class jumpsuit with a small living planet where his abdomen should be. He is Safe-class and never attacks anyone.
He does not occur naturally. Once his archive file has been read, he is found somewhere nearby, out in the open.
He wanders slowly, watches passers-by and often sits down to look at his planet.
He is happy to talk, and he does not seem to need anything.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp007.spawn.fail: There is no room for SCP-007 there
commands.scp_unleashed.scp007.gaze.none: There is no SCP-007 within %s blocks
commands.scp_unleashed.scp007.gaze.succe: SCP-007 sits down to look at his planet
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp007.0: Reports describe a tired man in a D-Class jumpsuit.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp007.1: Witnesses mention weather where his belly should be.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.0: It's raining over the little sea again. I can feel it.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.1: Shh. The night side is sleeping.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.2: Someone down there just flew a kite. It tickles.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.3: It's lighter than it looks. Heavier, sometimes.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.4: I named the big continent. It never answered.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.5: If you're quiet, you can hear the tide.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.6: A volcano woke up this morning. I didn't mind.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.7: I wonder if they can see me from down there.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.8: The sun comes up somewhere near my belt.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.9: Please don't poke it. Someone always notices.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.10: I used to have a lot of opinions. Now I mostly have weather.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.line.11: Sometimes I hear little bells. I think it's a festival.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.decline.0: That's kind of you. I'm not hungry, though. I never am.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.decline.1: No thank you. I think it would just fall into the ocean.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.decline.2: Oh, I couldn't. Give it to someone who needs it.
message.scp_unleashed.scp007.decline.3: Thanks, but I haven't wanted anything in a long time.
